description: This file provides utility functions for managing a transaction database using SQLite, including initializing the database, computing a score based on past transactions, and adding new transactions.

methods.name: init_db()
methods.description: Initializes the database by creating the transactions table and pre-populating it with a sample transaction.

methods.name: float calculate_score(user_id: str, company_id: str, amount: float)
methods.description: Calculates a score for a transaction based on the sum of recent transaction amounts for a given company, with an intentional error trigger for specific company IDs.

methods.name: add_transaction(user_id: str, company_id: str, amount: float, score: float)
methods.description: Adds a new transaction record to the database with provided user ID, company ID, amount, and score.

ctags.name: add_transaction
ctags.pattern: /^def add_transaction(user_id: str, company_id: str, amount: float, score: float):$/
ctags.signature: (user_id: str, company_id: str, amount: float, score: float)

ctags.name: calculate_score
ctags.pattern: /^def calculate_score(user_id: str, company_id: str, amount: float) -> float:$/
